title: 瀚亚资管Edward Chan：芯片出口与电力审批收紧，AI算力供给缺口或扩大
speaker: Edward Chan

segments.en: The timing is interesting, right? Do you think, you know, given Jensen Huang's fall, do you think that actually helps anthropic this week?
segments.zh: 时机挺有意思，对吧？你觉得，鉴于黄仁勋的下滑，这周对Anthropic有帮助吗？

segments.en: I mean, with this IPO, I mean, there's this narrative here that now they have titan ship exports in this new regime.
segments.zh: 我是说，这次IPO，有种说法是现在他们在这个新格局下有了巨头级出口。

segments.en: And more scrutiny on China, does that in some way mean that open source models could be maybe further behind from the frontier?
segments.zh: 对中国更多审视，是否意味着开源模型可能离前沿更远？

segments.en: Yeah. So I think there's like multiple, so the frontier battleground here, right, you know, there's that central, right?
segments.zh: 是的，我觉得有多个，这里的前沿战场，对吧，有那个中心。

segments.en: Yeah. It affects many things, but yes, go ahead. Yeah.
segments.zh: 对，影响很多事，但是的，请讲。

segments.en: So there's that open source versus close source war going on, right?
segments.zh: 所以开源与闭源之战正在进行，对吧？

segments.en: If you have very tight control over close source model, especially in the US, of course, that will benefit the open source, you know, the close source model providers, right?
segments.zh: 如果你对闭源模型控制很紧，尤其在美国，那当然会利好开源，你知道，闭源模型提供商，对吧？

segments.en: And then on the other front is, you know, if you have very strict ship export rules on AI chips, and at the same time, you have very strict approval on US power, then where,
segments.zh: 另一方面，如果你对AI芯片有非常严格的出口规则，同时美国电力审批非常严格，那么，

segments.en: if demand is great, where are you going to build those data centers?
segments.zh: 如果需求很大，你打算在哪里建那些数据中心？

segments.en: If you can't ship your chip outside the US, and you don't approve for building more power in the US, that gap will widen in terms of what the supply chain is able to produce,
segments.zh: 如果你不能把芯片运出美国，又不批准在美国建更多电力，那么供应链能生产的缺口会扩大，

segments.en: and how much power can come online. And I think in 27, that gap is probably not as big versus if you look at 28, if that kind
segments.zh: 以及有多少电力能够上线。我认为在27年，这个缺口可能没有28年那么大，如果那种情况
